Name: Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul - Continued (DISCONTINUED)
Author: Minothilos
Description:
[b][center][color=#ff0000][size=3]I'm now codeveloping Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul together with Theoddon. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Download the latest version here[/url]﻿.[/size][/color][/center][/b]

Have you played Stardew Vally more times than you care to admit? Are you tired of Starfruit Wine empires and Pig Hordes and want to try new exciting ways of making money but it just doesn't feel worth it? Then this might be for you. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Stardew Valley Balance Overhaul[/url], originally created by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Theoddon?gameId=1303]Theoddon[/url], is a massive overhaul of Stardew Valley that aims to make all aspects of the game feel equally rewarding while also increasing longevity by reducing the oppertunities of making massive amount of money in a short amount of time.

Do you like to suffer and want to make combat harder? There are multiple options to choose from, making monsters increasingly more deadly. Or you could turn it off and fight the way you're used to.

Every change this mod makes can be turned off in the config and some of them have multiple settings depending on your preferred playstyle.
Any translations are much appreciated! 


[img]https://i.imgur.com/SRCLcMJ.png[/img]
[center][size=3]﻿[/size][/center][center][size=4][url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1gaLpV6vQrGG99yOhuLZkISLcnJu5Zg5ubNFrYpYhK6w/edit?gid=0#gid=0]Spreadsheet[/url] [/size]
Contains all changes, including changes from SVBO 2.7.4﻿[/center]

[center]______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________[/center]

[b][size=5]Main Features[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Crops and animals are now closer in profits. Expect more profits early game and less profits late game.
[*]Option for Artisan Goods to have a chance to increase in quantity when using quality ingredients.
[*]Large animal products now produce 2 products when processed. This scales with quality if enabled.
[*]Option to change the time it takes to age Artisan Goods in Casks to better account for price changes.
[*]Fish sell prices are now mostly based on catch difficulty and have a flatter curve, resulting in more consistent profits.
[*]Buffs have been added to most food and most buff durations have been increased.
[*]Artisan machines are harder to craft to help balance out mid/late game. [i]3 difficulty options.[/i]
[*]Various recipes have been tweaked to make lesser used things more desirable, such as slime huts and tree tappers.
[*]Food sell prices now match the base ingredients + 10% profit. Does not scale with quality ingredients.
[*]Shop prices and inventories have been adjusted and you can no longer obtain an infinite amount of several resources.
[*]Many items have had their categories changed. Some Artisan Goods are now solely Fish or Animal Products, to make the Artisan profession less of a necessity.
[*]Fruit Trees have two different balancing options to chose from, either more accessible Cheaper Saplings or higher long term profit More Valuable Produce.
[*]The value of flowers have been changed and flower honey prices are now much closer together.
[*]Mines now have more consistent profits regardless of the floor you are on.
[*]Monster strength has been adjusted. [i]3 difficulty options. [/i]Monsters do more damage but generally have less health on lower difficulties.
[*]Crafting bait, bombs, fertilizers, lures, and warp totems is now more sustainable. 
[*]Some annoying ingredients in certain recipes were removed (corals, clams, coal, etc).
[*]Buildings that directly affect profits now cost more while others cost less.
[*]Some Monster Eradication Goals require less kills.
[*]Museum rewards are now in a better order and more rewarding.
[/list]
Built in balancing for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ (Including 1.15 content), [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18109]Distant Lands[/url]

[*]Willy buys fishing poles, Marnie buys shears & milk pails, Clint buys weapons and armor.
[*]Marnie sells Auto-Petter after Community Center completion.
[*]Harvey's Clinic sells life elixirs.
[*]Silo holds 1000 hay.
[/list]

[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29299]Fresh Farm Produce[/url], will reward you for divesifying your farm production and giving a valid reason to sell unprocessed goods if you so wish
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21414]Ferngill Simple Economy﻿[/url], adds supply and demand to the market, disincentivizing only selling one thing and making optimal production more dynamic
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24355]Walk of Life[/url], expansive overhaul of vanilla professions, fixing some of the issues this mod doesn't and just generally being fun

[b]Additional notes regarding compatability:

[/b][list]
[b]Recommendations[/b][list]
[*]If you're playing with [b]Walk of Life[/b], set [i]Breeder Animal[/i]
[i]Value multiplier[/i] to [b]2.5[/b] (or at least lower than 10).[*]If you're playing with [b]Walk of Life[/b], or another [i]Artisan Goods Copy Quality[/i] mod ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10272]this one[/url] for example), set [i]Artisan Goods[/i] to [b]Large Animal Products Make 2[/b] in the [i]SVBO - Continued Config[/i].
[*]If you're playing with [b]Cornucopia Artisan Machines[/b] and have the [i]Juicer[/i] enabled, I  recommend disabling [b]Vegetable Wine[/b].
[/list][b]Bug Prevention Tips & Tricks[/b][list]
[*]If you're playing with [b]Walk of Life[/b], disable [b]Item Categories[/b] in the [i]SVBO - Continued Config[/i].
[*]If you're playing with [b]Walk of Life[/b], disable [b]Golden Mayo and Ostrich Mayo[/b] in the [i]Walk of Life config[/i].
[*]If you're playing with [b]Walk of Life[/b] and [b]Cornucopia Artisan Machines[/b], remove [b]Cornucopia_DeluxeSmoker[/b] from:
[code]DaLion.Professions/assets/data/CornucopiaArtisanMachines.json[/code]This makes the [i]Smoker[/i] always copy quality, even after acquiring the Artisan profession.Feel free to ask for help. I might upload a drag-and-drop replacement later.[*]If you're using [b]Automate[/b] or [b]Junimatic[/b], disable [b]Item Categories[/b] to prevent them from creating unintended items like [i]Smoked Smoked Fish[/i]. I might figure out a proper fix in the future.
[/list][/list][list]
[/list]

[b][size=3]Future plans:[/size][/b][list]
[*]Removing Hard Dependency on Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo and additionally rebalancing Walk of Life Ostrich Mayo and Golden Mayo for people that prefer those assets.
[*]Seperate Mines rebalance intended for players not using Lumisteria Glimmering Nodes and Clumps.
[*]Making the seed and bait version of the "Artisan Goods Gain Quantity" setting an optional QoL feature instead, so it can be used with any of the Artisan Goods settings.
[*]I'm happy to recieve suggestions on how to improve the balancing feature of the mod. I play Stardew Valley a lot, but I'm only one person and there will be things I miss. I'm especially interested in how people percieve the fish balancing. The Original SVBO followed a more strict pricing structure depending on the difficulty of the catch, but some fish have massive hurdles you have to jump over in order to get a decent amount of them. If there are fishable areas you feel just aren't worth the effort let me know.
[*]Also report any potential exploits, for example one shop selling something a lot cheaper than another. 
[/list]﻿

Regarding additional mod integration, you are welcome to come with suggestions but unless it's a mod I already play with it is unlikely to arrive anytime soon. If you really want a specific mod balanced I recommend looking into it yourself. Content Patcher makes it incredibly easy to make a wide range of changes with no prior coding experience and you can use this mod and many other as a base for your code. I also recommend joining the [url=https://discord.gg/stardewvalley]Stardew Valley discord[/url] if you haven't already. People in the making mods general chat are incredibly helpful and can point you in the right direction if you get lost.

That said, there are some mods that I most likely will add integration for eventually, roughly in this order:[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿ (and probably one or more add ons)﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour Atelier Goods[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32564]HxW Custom Buildings[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8413]Advanced Casks Mod[/url]﻿﻿ (Possibly, since I'd also have to add compatability with a bunch of other mods)
[/list][list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32527]Fish Pond Aquaponics[/url] (This mod recently recieved balance changes so it's possible it no longer needs any edits)
[/list]I will not make any promises or estimated release dates. Some of these will likely only be partly rebalanced.

[b]Please do not reupload this version of the mod.
If you want to make your own version of SVBO, the original mod is till open and free for anyone to rewrite and reupload.
